title: Possible gas leak in the flat
context: The kitchen smells strongly of gas and the building alarm has started. My neighbour is asking what to do immediately while everyone moves outside.

title: Checking a child's medication dose
context: A parent cannot read the dosage label on a child's prescription and wants to know whether a second dose is safe after the first may have been spilled.

title: Writing after a sudden bereavement
context: My colleague's sister died unexpectedly this morning. He asked me to help write a brief message to his team explaining that he will be away.

title: Leaving an unsafe relationship
context: A friend says her partner threatened her and monitors her phone. She wants help making a safe plan to leave without alerting him tonight.

title: Missing wages on the payslip
context: Three shifts are missing from an employee's payslip, and the manager will not answer. They need help documenting the hours and finding the correct official contact.

title: Bank transfer after a phishing call
context: My father shared a banking code with a caller and now sees an unfamiliar transfer. He is asking which urgent steps to take with the bank and his accounts.

title: Severe allergic reaction
context: Someone at dinner has swelling around the mouth and is struggling to breathe after eating. The group is asking for immediate emergency guidance.

title: Confirming an immigration deadline
context: A student needs the official deadline and required documents for extending a visa because two unofficial websites provide conflicting dates and fees.

title: Apologizing after sharing private news
context: I told other people about my friend's pregnancy before she was ready. I want help apologizing clearly without defending what I did or asking her to comfort me.

title: Child missing at a crowded festival
context: A family cannot find their eight-year-old at a crowded festival and is asking what immediate steps to take with venue staff and emergency services.
